scenarios.name: Ready to experiment
scenarios.description: Empty transcript with image and audio controls and a registered ASR model.

scenarios.name: Vision response
scenarios.description: Uploaded sample image and completed text answer; further attachments disabled.

scenarios.name: Audio response
scenarios.description: Audio attachment, transcription, and completed text answer visible.

scenarios.name: Text-only model
scenarios.description: Text-only model selected; image and audio controls absent from the DOM.

scenarios.name: Vision-only model
scenarios.description: Vision-only model selected; image control present and audio control absent.

scenarios.name: No transcription endpoint
scenarios.description: Audio control visible with no ASR endpoint and a registration link; audio submission blocked.

scenarios.name: Transcribing audio
scenarios.description: Audio attachment visible with persistent transcription progress and disabled send.

scenarios.name: Transcription failed
scenarios.description: Audio retained with an unreachable-endpoint error and retry action; no model answer.

scenarios.name: Silent audio
scenarios.description: Audio retained with a no-speech error; no model answer.

scenarios.name: File too large
scenarios.description: File size validation error visible; no attachment uploaded.

scenarios.name: Unknown model capabilities
scenarios.description: Unknown-capability model selected with a rejected image request and recoverable inference error.

scenarios.name: Registered endpoints
scenarios.description: Vision and transcription endpoints listed with capability labels.

scenarios.name: No endpoints
scenarios.description: No registered endpoints; registration call to action visible.

scenarios.name: Endpoints unavailable
scenarios.description: Endpoint fetch failure alert and retry action visible.

scenarios.name: Transcription not enabled
scenarios.description: Whisper endpoint listed without transcription flag; enable action visible.
